title: Tencent Video's Internal Test of WorkSolo: Layout for AI Short Drama and Interactive Film Creation Platform
excerpt: Tencent Video's Intelligent Creation Platform Department is currently testing the AIGC content creation platform WorkSolo, which covers three core creative mode
content_html:
Tencent Video's Intelligent Creation Platform Department is currently testing the AIGC content creation platform WorkSolo, which covers three core creative modes: AI short dramas, interactive films, and free canvas. It provides AI-driven video production capabilities for a broader range of content creators.

According to the information, WorkSolo adopts a business model combining free trial, membership subscription, and integrated points-based computing power. When users use AI creation capabilities, they will consume points-based computing power. Members can purchase points packages and enjoy corresponding discounts. The platform also supports monthly and annual subscription cycles to meet different creative needs.

Previously, Tencent Video had launched the AI content production platform WorkRally. This platform is positioned as an industrial-level AI comic production platform, mainly targeting institutional teams and large-scale quality projects, offering a complete content production workflow, team collaboration capabilities, and professional film and television agent tools.

In comparison, WorkSolo is more geared towards individual creators and lightweight content production scenarios, while WorkRally focuses on professional and large-scale production needs. The two platforms have clear differentiated positioning, indicating that Tencent Video is building a dual-layer AIGC content product matrix covering both personal creation and professional production.

Additionally, several positions related to WorkSolo have recently appeared on Tencent's official recruitment platform, with work locations in Los Angeles, USA. It remains unclear whether WorkSolo will launch an independent overseas version or adapt its product capabilities for the international market.

As generative AI continues to penetrate the film and television production field, content production is gradually shifting from traditional manual processes to AI-assisted creation. By laying out AIGC tools at different levels, Tencent Video is expected to further explore the commercial applications of AI in short dramas, interactive content, and the film and television industrial process.

content_html_zh:
腾讯视频智能创作平台部目前正在测试AIGC内容创作平台WorkSolo，该平台涵盖AI短剧、互动电影、自由画布三大核心创作模式。 它为更广泛的内容创作者提供人工智能驱动的视频制作能力。

资料显示，WorkSolo采用免费试用、会员订阅、积分积分算力相结合的商业模式。 用户在使用AI创作能力时，会消耗积分算力。 会员可以购买积分套餐并享受相应折扣。 平台还支持包月和包年订阅周期，满足不同的创意需求。

此前，腾讯视频已推出AI内容制作平台WorkRally。 该平台定位工业级AI漫画制作平台，主要针对机构团队和大型优质项目，提供完整的内容制作流程、团队协作能力以及专业的影视代理工具。

相比之下，WorkSolo 更面向个人创作者和轻量级的内容制作场景，而 WorkRally 则专注于专业化、规模化的制作需求。 两个平台差异化定位明显，表明腾讯视频正在构建涵盖个人创作和专业制作的双层AIGC内容产品矩阵。

此外，近期腾讯官方招聘平台上也出现了多个与WorkSolo相关的职位，工作地点位于美国洛杉矶。 目前尚不清楚WorkSolo是否会推出独立的海外版本或针对国际市场调整其产品功能。

随着生成式AI不断渗透影视制作领域，内容制作正逐渐从传统的手工流程转向AI辅助创作。 通过不同层面布局AIGC工具，腾讯视频有望进一步探索AI在短剧、互动内容、影视产业流程等方面的商业应用。
